**#717 refreshed the priority handoff — the stale blocker queue over-reported the blockage 13-to-6**

**What**: Refreshed `docs/inbox/AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md` against `main` @ `9e9cd36`. Worktree `/home/scit/code/brain-issue-717`, branch `docs/issue-717-docsinbox-agent-priority-handoffmd-has-f`, commit `468f86f` (198+/101- on the doc). NOT pushed — Tier 2 awaits the human.

**New cut**: 66 open issues · 0 open PRs · 31 signed ADRs.

**Invariant outcomes**: three of four failed (`3eff9af`→`9e9cd36`; 59→66 issues; malformed-ADR count "exactly one"→ZERO after #676 landed via PR #692 repair then PR #696 test). The fourth held — registry 404 (express control 200), `publish.yml` 0 runs. **#435 has not moved across four cuts.**

**The finding worth keeping — a hand-maintained blocker queue OVER-reports the blockage.** The previous §7 listed 13 unsigned tickets; only six are unsigned (#268 #327 #588 #631 #697 #699). Nine had been signed without the document noticing. An agent trusting it would have left signed work untaken. Same family as §8's pattern, seen from the side where silence reads as an obstacle rather than as health.

**Measurement gotcha (cost me a near-false correction)**: `grep -c '^\*\*Status\*\*:'` over `brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md` returns **1** and looks healthy, which almost made me report §3 Route A as stale. It is not — the guard counts the artefact the run WOULD write, after `transformDraft` prepends its own signature header. `locateStatusLines(raw)` returns 3, and the real reproduction is `transformDraft(raw,{gitUserName,today})` → `checkShippedContent({writes:[{relPath, text}]})`, which refuses with "2 `**Status**:` line(s)". **The field names are `relPath`/`text`** — passing `path`/`content` throws inside `guard.applies` instead of reporting. Also: `brain:promote` refuses to run without a TTY by design, so verify via the library, never by faking a pty.

**Method that caught a real error in my own draft**: wrote a script that parses the four §5 line-sections, extracts `#NNN`, filters to the live open set, and asserts the buckets are disjoint and sum to the open count. It caught #256 double-counted (Línea 2 and Línea 3) and #323 duplicated within Línea 2. Final partition: instalación 10 · flujo 35 · memoria 8 · management 13 = 66.

**Verification**: every PR number cited confirmed MERGED via `gh pr view`; `brain:repo:check` clean; `test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs` 10/10; 299 changed lines vs the 1000-line `lite` budget (`docs/**` is NOT in `governance.ignoreList` — #327 wants to change that and is still unsigned).

**Related**: [[discovery/memory-records-duplicate-rec-95740755792f0f1c]] — documented in the refreshed §2 so a cold agent stops reading the warning as corruption. [[discovery/issue-723-skipped-never-wired]] — now §5 Línea 4 and §8's closing paragraph.
